doc_001_chunk_035 provides evidence about operational lessons the cache modernization.
Helios reduced Orion load, but it also introduced invalidation, version tracking, partition management, failover, warm-up behavior, and new security requirements.
Sentinel continues to monitor cache hit rate, invalidation delay, record lifetime, node health, fallback usage, and Orion query volume.
Helios improved dashboard speed because it reused metadata across Meridian workers.

It remained reliable because Orion stayed authoritative, Aurora carried durable invalidations, version numbers handled reordered events, request coalescing reduced duplicate fills, and rate-limited fallback protected the database during failures.
